title: Exactness of the normalized rational point fibre
statement: Fix D, l and E as in [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], with l different from the characteristic. The specified rational fibre, composed with the full-subcategory inclusion into the derived category of E-modules, admits an integer-shift comparison carrying every distinguished triangle of the raw rational constructible category [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] to a distinguished triangle. No equivalence or essential-surjectivity assertion is made.

source.place: Exactness of the normalized rational point fibre; extracted from the point-fibre argument; lean/Sheaf/Paper/PointRationalFibreExact.lean, pointRationalFibre_exact

proof.text: Integral sections followed by flat scalar extension to E is the exact termwise functor defining the large rational fibre. Its derived functor commutes with shifts and preserves distinguished triangles. The canonical exact carrier lift on bounded finite-dimensional complexes is an equivalence. Its counit transports the comparison to the small integral-rational fibre, with the specified object and morphism normalization.

First prove that the bounded finite-dimensional target predicate is closed under isomorphisms and distinguished triangles: the homology sequence bounds the support by the union of the two outer supports and gives finite-dimensionality of the middle term. Equip the carrier-size descent with the shift structure induced by its counit with the exact size lift, and transport exactness by that counit. The pure-tensor formula with coefficient one identifies the restriction of the specified rational fibre along localization with the integral-rational fibre. The existing proved private rawLocalization helper in ScalarExtensionExactIntrinsic supplies the raw localization universal property; no new localization theorem is assumed. Descend its shift comparison through localization using the shift universal property. Its zero and addition equations descend by faithfulness of precomposition. Every distinguished rational triangle is isomorphic to the localization of an integral distinguished triangle. The factorization isomorphism commutes with shifts, hence identifies all three arrows of the corresponding image triangles; closure under isomorphisms proves exactness.

    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)

      ∀ T, T ∈ distTriang _ →
        (@Functor.mapTriangle _ _ _ _ _ _ _ c).obj T ∈ distTriang _
